instruction: Candid cinematic film still, medium shot at eye-level. In a misty outdoor courtyard with a yellow building, the dark-haired man in the navy suit (R1) on the left and the blonde man in the black velvet suit (R2) on the right are slow-dancing together. The dark-haired man (R1) smiles warmly, holding the blonde man's (R2) hand raised, while the blonde man's (R2) other hand rests on his waist. In the background, two blurred men in suits cheer, one holding a white bouquet. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight with a misty, warm yellow palette.
